FROM BUILD PLATE TO ROBOT

A little glue. A clean finish.

01

Print the two faces

Print the plate model twice: red and blue. Put the flat outer face on the bed, with the strip recesses facing up. The recessed inner face looks mirrored; the outward face reads correctly. Do not mirror either STL in your slicer.

02

Print the white insert

The digits on both sides are joined by three hidden strips. Use opaque white filament. The double-sided insert needs supports; inspect it in your slicer.

03

Fit, glue, flip

Test fit first. Turn one colored plate over about its vertical axis, keeping the top edge upright. Seat the insert in the recesses; both outward faces read correctly. Glue lightly and clamp flat.

Before heading to the field

No mounting or locking holes are included. Choose a mounting method that hides the opposite alliance color. Geometry is checked before download; physical fit and event inspection remain yours to verify. Test a print before making your final plates.
